verdict.rationale: Databricks documents an official CLI and workspace REST APIs for headless automation, with a versioned SQL API path (api/2.0/sql/queries). Unity Catalog objects are explicitly reachable through SQL, the CLI and REST APIs, and Unity Catalog enforces access control and audit logging on every query. Databricks Connect and the Python SDK also let agent code run against Databricks compute without a dashboard. missing for 10: an explicit doc on executing ad-hoc SQL and fetching result sets through the API/CLI, documented CLI/API authentication flow for agents, an explicit schema-discovery command walkthrough, and independent hands-on corroboration.
